{{Top|leg}}
'''Heat trips''' were a specialized form of [[sensor trip]] that used an automated [[Heat detector|heat sensor]]. They detected passing heat sources and could be programmed to ignore specific heat patterns. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] units patrolling near [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bases employing heat trips often used heat-producing elements in their [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to pass by the trips without triggering them. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] manufactured the [[Heat Sensor Trip]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
